The '''Five Holy Cities''' were [[City/Legends|cities]] founded by religious crusaders<ref name="CEI" /> on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[New Holgha]],<ref name="PM" /> which was best known for them.<ref name="CEII" /> The [[Yuuzhan Vong]] [[Battle of New Holgha|attacked]] the planet three [[Standard month/Legends|months]] after they launched their [[Yuuzhan Vong War|galactic invasion]]. Although the Five Holy Cities were evacuated just before the attack,<ref name="CEI" /> the alien invaders still scoured them for sustenance for their giant, organic warships.<ref name="PM" /><ref name="CEI" />
{{City-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The Five Holy Cities first appeared in [[Karen Traviss]]' [[2006]] novella ''[[Boba Fett: A Practical Man]]''.<ref name="PM" />
